neronotes.menu.open_failed: This screen could not be opened. Please try again.
neronotes.tooltip.resonant_block.tap: Tap to sound its note; sneak-tap to tune it a step higher.
neronotes.tooltip.resonant_block.resonan: Flares and retunes when nearby resonance of its family plays.
neronotes.tooltip.resonator.disk: Plays a composition to its resonance channel, in sync for every listener.
neronotes.tooltip.resonator.bind: Binds to its placer's channel; only the owner, trusted players or an operator control it.
neronotes.tooltip.harmonic_gate.energy: Charges from any Neroland or Forge Energy power source.
neronotes.tooltip.harmonic_gate.travel: Once charged — and industrial power is yours — it carries you into the Soundforge.
neronotes.tooltip.transport_lectern.sequ: Opens the sequencer to compose your session score.
neronotes.tooltip.transport_lectern.plac: Only works inside the Soundforge — composition happens there.
neronotes.tooltip.pattern_wall.select: Tap to select the shown layer as your active layer.
neronotes.tooltip.pattern_wall.retune: Sneak-tap to retune the wall to the next layer slot.
neronotes.tooltip.voice_pedestal.select: Tap to cycle your active layer through this family's voices.
neronotes.tooltip.voice_pedestal.retune: Sneak-tap to retune the pedestal to the next voice family.
neronotes.tooltip.disk_press.budget: Writes your session score onto a blank disk — over-budget scores are refused, never trimmed.
neronotes.tooltip.disk_press.anonymous: Pressing anonymously is a first-class choice; credit is yours to give or withhold.
neronotes.tooltip.blank_disk: An unwritten resonant disk. The Disk Press in the Soundforge gives it a voice.
neronotes.tooltip.custom_disk.empty: This disk carries no readable composition.
neronotes.disk.author: By %s
neronotes.resonator.no_disk: This Resonator holds no composition yet.
neronotes.resonator.denied: Only the channel owner, trusted players or an operator may control this Resonator.
neronotes.resonator.channel_busy: Too many channels are already playing nearby.
neronotes.gate.entered: The Harmonic Gate carries you into the Soundforge.
neronotes.gate.returned: The Soundforge releases you — you are back where you started.
neronotes.gate.returned_fallback: No return anchor was found, so the gate set you down at the world spawn.
neronotes.gate.sealed: The Harmonic Gate is sealed — industrial power must flow before the Soundforge opens.
neronotes.gate.not_charged: The Harmonic Gate hums faintly; it needs more energy for a crossing.
neronotes.gate.unavailable: The Soundforge is not available in this world.
neronotes.command.soundforge_return.not_: You are not in the Soundforge.
neronotes.command.player_only: Only a player can use this command.
neronotes.sequencer.title: Soundforge Sequencer
neronotes.sequencer.outside: The console is silent — composition happens inside the Soundforge.
neronotes.sequencer.hint: Click the grid to place or remove notes on the active layer.
neronotes.sequencer.layer_selected: Layer %s is now your active layer.
neronotes.sequencer.no_such_layer: Your session has no layer %s yet.
neronotes.sequencer.no_session: Open the transport lectern first to start a session.
neronotes.press.title: Disk Press
neronotes.press.outside: The press is still — it only works inside the Soundforge.
neronotes.press.no_blank: Place a blank resonant disk in the input slot first.
neronotes.press.output_full: Take the pressed disk before pressing another.
neronotes.press.empty_score: Your session score has no notes yet — there is nothing to press.
neronotes.press.over_budget: This composition is %s bytes; the Disk Press limit is %s bytes. Trim the score — the press never truncates.
neronotes.press.name_empty: Give the composition a title first.
neronotes.press.name_too_long: That title is too long — at most %s characters.
neronotes.press.name_blocked: That title is not allowed on this server.
neronotes.press.done: The press hums — your composition is written.
